name: James Beran
abstract_title: Launching a Conscious Quantum Chip Startup?--You Need an Expert in the Science of Consciousness!
abstract: The science of consciousness has many applications (see, e.g., Cleeremans et al., 2025). An example of great interest today is the quest for conscious quantum chips. Quantum chip technology continues to make remarkable progress, with major companies announcing new, more powerful quantum chips such as Google’s Willow, Microsoft’s Majorana, Amazon’s Ocelot, and IBM’s Heron.
